This is the conclusion to a four-part storyline about the [[Destiny|fate]] of [[Asajj Ventress]], the [[Nightsisters]], and two of the [[Nightbrothers]], which began with the last three episodes: "[[Massacre]]," "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]," and "[[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]]." It first aired on [[March 14]] in France on W9, before its official premiere on [[Cartoon Network]] on [[March 16]], [[2012]]. This episode is chronologically followed by [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five's]] second episode, "[[A War on Two Fronts]]." ==Official description== ''"''Savage and Maul, now reunited, pursue Obi-Wan Kenobi in search of revenge, and the Jedi Knight finds himself forced to unite with a surprising ally to defend against the deadly siblings.''"'' ==Opening narration== {{OpeningCrawl |name=Episode 22
REVENGE |text=Brothers reunited! Darth Maul, the sinister Sith thought to have been destroyed so many years ago by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, was found alive by his brother, Savage Opress, and taken back to Mother Talzin on Dathomir. Though Darth Maul's memory has yet to be fully restored, his need for vengeance has awakened, more powerful than ever....}} ==Plot summary== {{Quote|I've waited so many years for my revenge, I can wait a little longer.|Maul, to Savage Opress|}} Reunited, [[Maul]] and [[Savage Opress]] travel back to [[Dathomir]], where the [[brother]]s are led by [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]] to [[Nightsister lair|her village]], where she removes Maul's [[spider]]-like [[cybernetics]] and uses [[magick]]s to create new cybernetic [[Limb|leg]]s, as well as restore Maul's sanity. Once back to full health and reborn, Maul reminisces about surviving his dark path of being discarded, forgotten, and lost, with only his hatred keeping his [[Bedlam Spirits|spirit]] intact. As Maul felt [[the Force]] was out of balance, he learns from Savage that there is an ongoing conflict: the [[Clone Wars]]. Realizing the Clone Wars began without him, Maul felt that he was robbed of his [[destiny]] of being more than an [[Sith apprentice]] to the "[[Darth Sidious|most powerful being in the galaxy]]." Although Savage believes Maul can begin again, the two brothers agree to wreak Maul's revenge on the [[Jedi]] who reduced him to his state: [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. To bring him to them, Maul and Opress travel to a village on the planet [[Raydonia]], slaughter the inhabitants and send a [[hologram]] message to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]], challenging Obi-Wan to come to them. Despite [[Mace Windu]]'s suggestion to send in a Jedi task force, Obi-Wan decides that he must go alone to rectify his mistake. But as Windu expresses his concerns about this undertaking, [[Yoda]] cryptically states that Obi-Wan will not be alone in this endeavor – and as he speaks, in a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina|certain place]] on [[Tatooine]], [[Asajj Ventress]] learns of a reward placed on the head of Savage Opress and goes off after him. Obi-Wan travels to the Raydonian village and is quickly taken down by Maul and Opress, who take him aboard [[TR-RL3 Terrapin-class bulk tanker|their hijacked freighter]] to be tortured to death. However, just before they take off, Ventress has landed on the planet, found their ship and hitched a ride. Appearing before the two brothers, she taunts them saying Savage is still an animal, making them abandon an unconscious Obi-Wan to search for her. Ventress returns to Obi-Wan, wakes him up and lends him one of [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers|her lightsabers]] for his defense when Maul and Opress return. The two team up in order to [[Skirmish above Raydonia|fight]] the brothers, but find themselves outmatched and just barely escape by jettisoning the ship's [[Escape pod|cockpit]], leaving Maul and Opress adrift. Despite this setback, Maul is satisfied that the Jedi will yet come after him once more and that he will get his revenge after all. ==Continuity== [[File:Staw.png|thumb|200px|The red logo of "[[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]]" and "Revenge".|alt=]] "Revenge" was the second episode in the series to feature a red opening logo, rather than the standard yellow one. The [[Brothers (episode)|previous episode]] also featured this logo, for the first time, due to the return of Darth Maul. According to a behind the scenes feature at StarWars.com, the turtle tanker is not actually stranded in space, as there is a second control pod in the tanker. Maul is seen in it at the end of the episode. Maul's appearance in this episode comes from the comic ''[[Old Wounds]]''. ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|imagecat=Images from Revenge (episode)}} ===Collected in=== *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Darth
